title: Flowing data
direction: Composition: an elegant wide pale-lavender hero with the main title, subtitle and primary CTA on its left. On the right create an original large floating technical illustration: three translucent lavender source tables flowing along fine violet curved lines through a small circular junction into one regional dashboard card, with subtle scattered geometric shapes. Below the hero, a wide left white content card holds the incident quote and the complete operating contract; a narrower right card holds the complete working environment. Use a lavender diagonal-pattern band at the top of the environment card with a circular outlined notebook icon. Richly illustrated yet calm, sophisticated and closest to existing lab visual language. Hero is around 300 px tall; the lower content remains readable.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop website redesign concept as a single raster image, landscape approximately 1920 x 1400. This is the challenge opening page in the Materialize Learning Lab, titled "Save the Flash Sale". Show the complete useful page, no browser chrome, no device frame, no collage, no captions outside the webpage. Crisp legible interface typography. The goal is a fun inviting learning challenge briefing with generous custom background drawings and patterns, while keeping detailed learning information highly readable. Reference style described: pale lavender translucent geometric diagonal ribbons, delicate violet outlined database tables and connector paths, restrained flat technical illustration. Use original artwork in that family, do not copy provided artwork. Materialize visual identity: white/off-white, near-black headings, vivid violet #6037EA, muted lavender, small restrained supporting accents. Keep a recognizable slim header: purple geometric M mark, "Materialize", divider, "Learning Lab", right "Docs ↗" and sun/moon theme icons. Breadcrumb "Learning path › Challenge". Show "10–20 minutes · Chapters 1–8". Render all the following information, with clear hierarchy and comfortable body text; do not substitute large blank placeholders for prose, do not reduce this to a sparse marketing page. Main title "Save the Flash Sale"; subtitle "Investigate the discrepancy. Repair the system. Prove it is ready for the next sale wave." Section "An incident from operations", quote "Regional totals disagree with the latest paid orders during the flash sale. Can we trust this dashboard before the next sale wave?" Paragraph "You have inherited Northstar Shop’s dashboard. Investigate the system, make reversible changes, and hand over evidence that it meets the operating contract. Choose where to look and what to test." Section "Operating contract" with five distinct readable requirements: "Paid-order counts and totals by customer region, during [event time, event time + five minutes)." "A correction replaces the previous version of the same order." "Normal snapshots are at most three seconds old. During the incident, a labeled ten-second fallback or unavailable response is authorized." "The application publishes complete results and never exposes a partial timestamp." "Operations and support share one durable result, with local serving indexes, within eight illustrative state units." Section "Your working environment" with prose: "Explore the data, deployed SQL, system observations, and application in any order. A notebook keeps the evidence you choose to pin." "SQL queries execute locally. Streaming, connection progress, and cluster behavior use the lab simulation. No database credentials or infrastructure setup are needed." "Pause at any time. Drafts and applied changes resume automatically. Hints and worked repairs are optional and recorded honestly." A prominent violet button "Start investigation →" and secondary link "Back to main page". Do not expose hidden faults, solutions, numbered learning steps, a task checklist or invented live status metrics. Use tasteful artwork to explain context, not to crowd body text. title: Operations dossier
direction: Composition: an inviting incident briefing designed like a thoughtfully arranged operations dossier on a very pale lavender background. Header remains white. A large title and subtitle across the top with a delicate oversized angular watermark pattern tucked into the top right. Below, two main columns: left a wide white softly rounded briefing sheet with an inset lilac quotation area labeled "An incident from operations" and all five operating-contract paragraphs beneath it, small restrained line icons by the requirements. Right a smaller offset notebook-like panel titled "Your working environment", full prose, and an original playful violet line illustration of stacked query sheets, a data table, a small magnifying glass and connecting cable, no people. Bottom a strong wide purple CTA strip with "Start investigation →" and duration. Subtle paper shadows, generous composition, small diagram doodles in margins, professional product UI rather than literal stationery or a game.

title: Patterned canvas
direction: Composition: a spacious white website with a full-width lavender hero background of huge translucent diagonal geometric ribbons and a fine violet stream path threading through the corners. Hero title and subtitle are left aligned, and the operations quote sits in a broad lavender outlined inset beneath it, with a small circular flag icon. To the hero's right create a minimalist original line illustration of a shopping bag, order table and pulse-shaped data stream. Beneath the hero present two nearly equal columns: "Operating contract" on the left containing all five detailed requirements in a clean vertical list, and "Your working environment" on the right containing all full paragraphs. Include the inherited dashboard paragraph immediately above the two-column area. The section headings each have their own short pale lavender patterned banner. Footer area has main CTA and secondary link. Warm playful energy through bold abstract pattern rhythm, fine line drawings, precise clear text.

title: Bold split
direction: Composition: a distinctive bold split-layout redesign. After the shared white navigation header and breadcrumb, the body is split into a rich deep-violet left story panel about 35% of width and a white right reading surface about 65%. Left panel has the large white title, lavender subtitle, time/chapter metadata, prominent white "Start investigation →" button with violet text and the secondary link. Fill the lower half of that panel with a gorgeous original lavender-and-white technical drawing of layered database tables, flowing lines, small commerce symbols and translucent angular ribbons. Right area has the incident heading, quote in a tinted lavender callout and inherited-system paragraph at top. Below show the entire five-item operating contract, then the entire working-environment description in a gentle pale lavender card. Distinctive asymmetry, editorial typography, restrained shadows, excellent text contrast. Keep body copy a clear readable size; full page can be taller to fit all information.

title: Northstar Shop
direction: Composition: friendly bright polished website opening page built around an original small isometric commerce world. Across the top below navigation, create a pale lavender illustrated hero: large title and subtitle at left with time/chapter badge, and at right an elegant abstract Northstar shop storefront with tiny order cards flowing on violet tracks into a regional dashboard and notebook. No human characters, no photorealistic stock photos, no fake data numbers. The store illustration uses lavender, white and violet with tiny peach and teal accents, subtle long shadows, flat vector-like precision. Beneath hero, a wide incident card with the quote and full inherited-dashboard paragraph. Below that a 60/40 two-column layout with complete operating contract on left and full working-environment prose on right. Contract rows use tiny original outline icons. Subtle dots and thin curved paths in outer whitespace make it lively; use light patterned section tops and a clear purple CTA at the bottom. Maintain professional Materialize feel and all detailed copy.
